note: Declared conflicts only: cross-kind material tensions that no algebra over the two constraints settles, each seeded from a measured row of docs/artist/element-preflight.md and from nowhere else. Anything provable belongs in derive.ts, and anything unmeasured is not a conflict yet. A declared conflict is a claim about THIS medium at THIS canvas size; it is only as good as the measurement behind it, and the measurement is cited per entry.

conflicts.note: Horror vacui against the charged interval, as ink density against coverage. Row R3 of docs/artist/element-preflight.md: over 29 measured programs, 16 satisfy ink >= 0.35 and 8 satisfy coverage <= 0.30; none satisfies both, and the highest ink reached anywhere under coverage 0.30 is 0.2500 (pf-aligned-64cells), a margin of 0.10 below the floor. Declared and not derived because the bound that makes it empty is a property of the 16x16 measurement grid and the 600x900 sheet, not of the two constraints' parameters: on a floor-boundary grid a block landing on the wide cells carries slightly more area per unit of coverage, and pf-aligned-99cells measures ink 0.3874 against coverage 0.3867, so 'ink <= coverage' is false by 7.29e-4 and cannot be used as a proof. The same tension written as ink >= 0.35 against coverage <= 0.40 IS satisfiable and was rejected: pf-aligned-100cells sits at 0.3903/0.3906.
